exposure: 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D) concentrations at 36 weeks' corrected gestational age
cohort: 44 preterm infants born before 29 completed weeks of gestation.
finding: Neither cord blood 25(OH)D levels nor 25(OH)D levels at 36 weeks' corrected age were associated with the development of BPD in this cohort of extremely preterm infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a considered confounding variable in the analysis but no specific findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
